top_signals.title: Ladbrokes-owner and Aston Martin on chopping block in FTSE reshuffle
top_signals.summary: Ladbrokes-owner Entain and Aston Martin are among a handful of firms facing the chopping block in the looming quarterly reshuffle of the London market indices. Entain is slated to tumble out of the FTSE 100 after a bruising period, made worse by the increase of taxes on bookies. The betting business “has battled with high [...]
